name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_filter_rightValue_le_one

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_affineRootSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_affineRootSet {p A : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {r : ZMod p} :
    r ∈ affineRootSet p A hp ↔ (A : ZMod p) * r + 1 = 0

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_badResidueSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_badResidueSet_iff {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {r : ZMod p} :
    r ∈ L.badResidueSet p hp ↔
      ((L.leftSlope : ZMod p) * r + 1) * ((L.rightSlope : ZMod p) * r + 1) = 0

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_primePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_primePairSet {R r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.primePairSet R ↔
      1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ R ∧ (L.leftValue r).Prime ∧ (L.rightValue r).Prime

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_siftedPairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_siftedPairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.siftedPairSet R z ↔
      1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ R ∧
        ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, ¬p ∣ L.leftValue r * L.rightValue r

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt
statement:
theorem mem_siftedPairSet_of_prime_values_gt {R z r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ L.primePairSet R)

    r ∈ L.siftedPairSet R z

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime_le
statement:
theorem abs_affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime_le {R z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    |(L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem p| ≤ L.shiftedBadResidueCount p

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.activePrimeProduct_squarefree
statement: theorem activePrimeProduct_squarefree (z : ℕ) : Squarefree (L.activePrimeProduct z)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_multSum
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_multSum (R z d : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).multSum d =
      (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem (R z d : ℕ) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card - L.sieveDensity d * R

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_eq_floor_add_excess {R z d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem d =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        L.residueExcessCount R d - L.sieveDensity d * R

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime
statement:
theorem affineBoundingSieve_rem_prime {R z p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (L.affineBoundingSieve R z).rem p =
      (L.residueExcessCount R p : ℝ) -
        (L.shiftedBadResidueCount p : ℝ) * (R % p : ℕ) / p

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_cast_eq_main_add_error {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card : ℝ) =
      (L.shiftedBadResidueCount d : ℝ) * (R / d : ℕ) +
        L.residueExcessCount R d

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_divisibleParameterSet_eq
statement:
theorem card_divisibleParameterSet_eq {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (L.divisibleParameterSet R d).card =
      L.shiftedBadResidueCount d * (R / d) + L.residueExcessCount R d

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:
theorem card_leftSmallPrimePairSet_le (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z).card ≤ z + 1

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
theorem card_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (a : Fin d) :
    (parameterResidueFiber R d a).card =
      R / d + if a.val < R % d then 1 else 0

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add
statement:
theorem card_primePairSet_le_sifted_add (R z : ℕ) :
    (L.primePairSet R).card ≤ (L.siftedPairSet R z).card + 2 * (z + 1)

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.card_rightSmallPrimePairSet_le
statement:

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.coprime_activePrimeProduct_iff
statement:

      ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesLE z, ¬p ∣ L.shiftedProductValue t

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem divisibleParameterSet_eq_biUnion {R d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :

statement:

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_divisibleParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisibleParameterSet {R d t : ℕ} :

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_leftSmallPrimePairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.leftSmallPrimePairSet R z ↔
      r ∈ L.primePairSet R ∧ L.leftValue r ≤ z

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_parameterResidueFiber
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_parameterResidueFiber {R d : ℕ} {a : Fin d} {t : ℕ} :

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet
statement:

theorem mem_rightSmallPrimePairSet {R z r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ L.rightSmallPrimePairSet R z ↔
      r ∈ L.primePairSet R ∧ L.rightValue r ≤ z

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_selbergSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_selbergSupport {R N : ℕ} :

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_shiftedBadResidueSet

theorem mem_shiftedBadResidueSet {d : ℕ} {t : Fin d} :

name: RankAmplification.AffinePrimePair.mem_siftedParameterSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_siftedParameterSet {R z t : ℕ} :

      t < R ∧ Nat.Coprime (L.activePrimeProduct z) (L.shiftedProductValue t)

name: RankAmplification.deriv_reciprocalLogKernel
statement:
theorem deriv_reciprocalLogKernel {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t * Real.log t)⁻¹) x =
      -((Real.log x + 1) / (x ^ 2 * Real.log x ^ 2))

      Chebyshev.theta R / R + ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R, Chebyshev.theta t / t ^ 2

name: RankAmplification.primeLogReciprocalSum_le
statement:
theorem primeLogReciprocalSum_le {R : ℕ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) :

name: RankAmplification.primeLogReciprocalSum_nonneg

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log (Real.log R) - Real.log (Real.log 2) + (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
      2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R))

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_aux
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_aux {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      primeReciprocalSum R + 2 * δ * primeLogReciprocalSum R

name: RankAmplification.primeRankinSum_le_loglog_three_mul
statement:
theorem primeRankinSum_le_loglog_three_mul {R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hR : 2 ≤ R)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδR : δ * Real.log R ≤ 1) :
    primeRankinSum R δ ≤
      Real.log 4 *
        (Real.log (Real.log (3 * (R : ℝ))) - Real.log (Real.log 2) +
          (Real.log 2)⁻¹) +
      2 * δ * (Real.log 4 * (1 + Real.log R))

      ∫ t in (2 : ℝ)..R,
        Chebyshev.theta t * (Real.log t + 1) / (t ^ 2 * Real.log t ^ 2)

name: RankAmplification.prime_rpow_neg_one_add_le
statement:
theorem prime_rpow_neg_one_add_le {p R : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpR : p ≤ R)

      (p : ℝ)⁻¹ + 2 * δ * (Real.log p / p)

name: RankAmplification.inverse_one_sub_le_exp_mul_inverse_one_sub
statement:
theorem inverse_one_sub_le_exp_mul_inverse_one_sub {a b t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a) (ha : a ≤ 1 / 2) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hdiff : a - b ≤ a * t) :
    (1 - a)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (2 * a * t) * (1 - b)⁻¹

name: RankAmplification.mertensFactor_le_softenedFactor
statement:

    (hbase : 2 ≤ base) (hiK : i < K)
    (hK : 3 ≤ bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base K) (hdensity : 0 ≤ density)
    (hsmooth :
      (finiteSmoothCount (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)
          (bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i) : ℝ) ≤
        bfpsShellMultiplierCutoff X Y base i * density) :
    bfpsLogSquaredScale (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i) *
        bfpsLogSmoothMultiplierMajorant X (bfpsGeometricEndpoint Y base i)

name: RankAmplification.log_reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth_le_log_one_add_logb

name: RankAmplification.mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet
statement:

theorem mem_residuePrimeIntervalSet {D a L U q : ℕ} :

      L < q ∧ q ≤ U ∧ q.Prime ∧ q ≡ a [MOD D]

theorem residuePrimeIntervalCount_le_div_add_one {D a L U : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_consecutive
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_consecutive {D a L M U : ℕ}
    (hLM : L ≤ M) (hMU : M ≤ U) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U =
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L M +
        residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a M U

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_dyadic_decomposition
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_dyadic_decomposition {D a J : ℕ}
    (hJ : 2 ≤ J) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (2 ^ (J + 1) * D) =
      residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a 0 (4 * D) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 J, dyadicResiduePrimeReciprocalSum D a j

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_eq_boundary_add_prefix
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_eq_boundary_add_prefix {D a L U : ℕ}
    (hLU : L < U) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U =
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L U : ℝ) * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1),
          (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L m : ℝ) /
            ((m : ℝ) * (m + 1))

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_card_mul_inv {D a L U : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U ≤
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L U : ℝ) * (L : ℝ)⁻¹

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_of_prefix_bound
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_le_of_prefix_bound {D a L U : ℕ}
    (hLU : L < U) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc (L + 1) U,
      (residuePrimeIntervalCount D a L m : ℝ) ≤ B m) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D a L U ≤
      B U * (U : ℝ)⁻¹ +
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ioc L (U - 1), B m / ((m : ℝ) * (m + 1))

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_mono_upper
statement:
theorem residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum_mono_upper {D a L U V : ℕ} (hUV : U ≤ V) :

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT {C : ℝ} {D J X : ℕ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 < D) (hJ : 2 ≤ J)
    (hX : X ≤ 2 ^ (J + 1) * D)
    (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D 1 J) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X ≤
      (5 + C * (1 + Real.log J)) * (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_canonical
statement:
theorem residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_canonical {C : ℝ} {D X : ℕ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 < D) (hX : 2 ≤ X)
    (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D 1
      (reciprocalBrunTitchmarshDepth X)) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 X ≤
      (5 + C * (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.logb 2 X))) *
        (D.totient : ℝ)⁻¹

name: RankAmplification.residuePrimeReciprocalSum_le_of_dyadicBT_endpoint
statement:

    (hBT : DyadicBrunTitchmarshHypothesis C D 1 J) :
    residuePrimeIntervalReciprocalSum D 1 0 (2 ^ (J + 1) * D) ≤

        if l ∣ d then s.nu d * minimizingWeight s d else 0) =

        if l ∣ d then s.nu d * weightFromDiagonal s y d else 0) = y l

name: RankAmplification.SelbergFundamental.errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_level_restriction
statement:
theorem errSum_lambdaSquared_minimizingWeight_eq_level_restriction
    (s : SelbergSieve) :
    s.errSum (BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s)) =
      ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          |BoundingSieve.lambdaSquared (minimizingWeight s) d| * |s.rem d|
        else 0

    (truncatedMass s)⁻¹ ≤

theorem isAboveCutoffDiagonal_natFloor_iff {Y : ℝ} (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (h n : ℕ) :
    IsAboveCutoffDiagonal h ⌊Y⌋₊ n ↔
      ∃ j r, IsSameSupportIndex h j ∧
        1 ≤ r ∧
        n = j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        n + h = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) (j + h) ∧
        Y < (largestPrimeFactor (diagonalGamma h j * r) : ℝ)

        1 ≤ r ∧
        n = j * (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        n + h = (j + h) * (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Prime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalA h j * r + 1) j ∧
        Nat.Coprime (diagonalB h j * r + 1) (j + h) ∧

      atTop (nhds 0))
    (h2 : Tendsto (fun x ↦

        C * (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingY x) / movingEtaR x)
      atTop (nhds 0))

      (movingJ x : ℝ) / movingEtaR x *
        (log2 (3 * movingZ x) + movingVsrc x / Real.log (movingVsrc x)))
      atTop (nhds 0)) :
